plugin.name: Free Web Search
plugin.description: Keyless web search and page reading. Works out of the box and falls back across several free backends. Ships a setup panel (optional one-paste Exa free API key), a two-way switch for the host's built-in search, a proxy-software compatibility toggle, and a network self-check; also supports proxies and your own SearXNG.
panel.title: Free Web Search
panel.subtitle: First time here? Register at Exa for a free key, or tap "Try the free way" and start searching right away.
panel.guide.title: Three steps (about 3 minutes)
panel.guide.intro: You can search without registering. An Exa key just makes it faster, steadier, and gives you a predictable quota.
panel.guide.freeNote: Exa registration needs no credit card. When the free money runs out it falls back to the free tier automatically — you are never charged.
panel.guide.step1.title: Step 1: register and get your key
panel.guide.step1.line1: Open this address (reachable directly, no proxy needed):
panel.guide.step1.line1b: If it will not open, copy it and paste it into your browser address bar.
panel.guide.step1.line2: Choose Continue with Email (Continue with Google does not work in mainland China). Any QQ or 163 mailbox works; if no mail arrives, check the spam folder first.
panel.guide.step1.line3: After logging in, click Create API Key, then copy the whole string. The "API Key" on that page is the key this panel means.
panel.guide.step2.title: Step 2: paste the key into the box below
panel.guide.step2.line1: Click into the box and paste the whole thing with Ctrl+V. No spaces before or after.
panel.guide.step3.title: Step 3: save and use it
panel.guide.step3.line1: Tap "Save and use" below — the plugin runs one live search to check it. If it works, Exa becomes the preferred source; if not, it tells you why and keeps using the free tier, so search never breaks.
panel.guide.keyField.label: Exa key
panel.guide.keyField.help: After saving, only the last four characters are shown here. The plain key never stays in the panel or in logs; only the plugin stores it.
panel.guide.keyField.placeholderGuide: Paste the key you just copied
panel.guide.keyField.placeholderReplace: Paste a new key (saving replaces the old one)
panel.guide.urlCopied: Address copied — paste it into your browser bar.
panel.guide.copyFailed: Copy did not work. Select the address above and copy it by hand.
panel.guide.keyEmpty: Paste a key first, or tap "Try the free way" on the left.
panel.guide.quota: How the quota works: $20 on sign-up, then $10 refreshes every month. One search costs about $0.007, so roughly 1400 searches a month, about 47 a day. No credit card, nothing is charged when it runs out — you get a 402 and the plugin switches to another search source.
panel.quota.fallback: It works without a key too: the shared free tier, but slower, with lower limits, and it acts up now and then.
panel.messages.keySaved: Key saved. Exa is now the preferred source.
panel.messages.keySaveFailed: The key was saved but this check did not pass, so the free tier keeps working for now.
panel.messages.keyRemoved: Key deleted — back to the free tier.
panel.messages.keyRemoveFailed: Delete did not go through. Tap it once more.
panel.messages.trialStarted: Switched to the free tier. You can start searching.
panel.messages.testOk: It works, the key is valid.
panel.messages.testFailed: This attempt did not work. Do not change other settings yet.
panel.messages.hostOn: The built-in web search is running again.
panel.messages.hostOff: The built-in web search is stopped; this plugin handles searching now.
panel.messages.hostFailed: The built-in web search state could not be changed.
panel.errors.actionUnavailable: This cannot be clicked right now: start this plugin first (or wait for it to finish starting) and try again.
panel.errors.ssrfFailed: Could not save that switch: try again, or edit ssrf_allow_ranges under [net] in the config page.
panel.errors.refreshFailed: The panel state did not refresh: {detail}
panel.errors.actionRegistryMissing: No actions are visible yet: start this plugin first, then tap "Refresh panel".
panel.confirm.removeMessage: After deleting it, the plugin goes back to the free tier: searching still works, just slower with lower limits. Delete it?
panel.done.title: Key management
panel.done.line1: Only a masked form of the key is shown here. To switch keys, paste the new one; to use the free tier only, tap "Delete".
panel.key.label: Current key
panel.trial.title: You are on the free tier
panel.trial.line1: Searching works without an account on the shared free tier — the price is slower, lower limits, and the odd hiccup. Want it fast and steady? Tap the button below to set up an Exa key (no credit card).
panel.chain.title: Search sources in use
panel.chain.empty: No usable search source yet. Wait for the plugin to finish starting, then tap "Refresh panel".
panel.chain.duckHidden: duckduckgo is not in the list right now: it only gets added when a proxy is detected, because direct connections in mainland China mostly get nothing from it.
panel.chain.duckShown: A proxy was detected, so duckduckgo was added as a spare source.
panel.host.title: Built-in "web search" plugin
panel.host.label: Stop the built-in "web search" (this plugin takes over)
panel.host.help: This switch is the intent: on = handed to this plugin, off = let the built-in keep running. The badge is what is actually true; "State unavailable" means the host management API did not answer.
panel.host.notFound: The built-in web search was not found — it may have been removed. This plugin is unaffected.
panel.host.notToggleable: This environment does not allow changing it here. Use the plugin manager in the host instead.
panel.diag.title: Network check
panel.diag.help: Tries each search source one by one and tells you what works directly and how long it takes.
panel.diag.scope: The check probes this plugin's own search channels ({chain}) — not the host's built-in search, and not the chat model.
panel.diag.exaWithKey: The exa row uses your saved key ({masked}), so it shows what a keyed request does.
panel.diag.exaAnonymous: No key saved yet: the exa row uses the shared anonymous tier, so being slow and limited is normal there.
panel.diag.hostUnrelatedOn: The host's built-in search is running, but it takes no part in this check — this plugin does not go through it.
panel.diag.hostUnrelatedOff: The host's built-in search is stopped; that changes nothing in this check.
panel.diag.cost: The check performs real searches (one per source, two with the proxy path on) and uses quota. Run it only when something feels off.
panel.diag.none: No details came back this time — it may have been too slow, or the plugin was still starting.
panel.diag.emptyResult: The check returned nothing. Try again in a moment.
panel.diag.column.name: Source
panel.diag.dual: Test through the proxy as well
panel.diag.dualAuto: Currently following the detected proxy ({state}). Switch it to decide yourself.
panel.diag.dualHelp: Doubles the probes and the quota the check costs, but it is the only way to see which sources need the proxy.
panel.net.fakeIpHelp: If your proxy hands out fake addresses (like 198.18.x.x), keep this allowed so page text can still be fetched. No idea? Leave it as it is.
